role: Independent TD architecture and technical debt
technical_assessment: No material blocker found in scoped integrated review. Noncloneable origin-checked reservation transfers the same shared permit once to worker lease; rejected requests release it by RAII.
Authorization, lightweight retention and declared-size preflight precede multipart body reads. Retry reserves before retained-input fetch; acceptance rechecks authorization and retention.
Detached acceptance owns both durable commit and launch. HTTP response loss during commit cannot drop an accepted job before launch; restart interruption remains explicit.
Identifier exhaustion produces controlled distinct errors, while only genuine capacity exhaustion returns retryable busy. Conversion codec and PostgreSQL schema V3 remain unchanged in 0.8.1.
debt_and_limits: These document and admission limits are not a hard RAM ceiling or global storage quota.
Form submission is not exactly-once. Acceptance may complete after response loss; inspect saved attempts before explicit retry.
Unknown-length body may consume one supplied frame beyond the limit; actual instrumented excess was80bytes. TCP bytes sent do not establish server bytes consumed.
The fixed18MiB/two-event case measures byte volume, not worst-case event/report expansion. Ordered sampled process observations do not establish production RAM bounds, throughput SLO or speedup.
Storage or authorization failures can leave the last durable Running state until owner action or restart. Cooperative cancellation can wait for a third-party call to exit.
preserved_history: Original measurement whole trial remains FAILED; later TCP/restart success uses separate process lifetimes, not a rewritten whole successful trial. Original TCP errno remains UNKNOWN.
Primary compile04 child exit/EOF, capacity compile11 clippy capture and capacity browser01 PostgreSQL exit/EOF remain UNKNOWN. Outer EOF does not prove child EOF.
